title: Driver Tee It High Let It Fly (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica fiddle
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the driver is the big stick
Tee it high, let it fly
Thats the rule of the long ball

[Verse 1]
Tee it up so half the ball sits above the crown
Thats one and a half inches off the ground
Ball position off the lead heel, way forward
Wide stance, shoulder and a half, look toward

[Pre-Chorus]
Spine tilts away from the target, son
Trail shoulder lower, lead shoulder up
Catch it on the up, three degrees positive
Thats the launch you wanna live with

[Chorus]
Driver tee it high, let it fly
Upper cut the ball, watch it climb the sky
Wide base, ball forward, spine tilted right
Swing it smooth, son, swing it polite

[Verse 2]
Grip pressure three out of ten on the driver
Swing it smooth, dont be a high diver
Eighty percent effort, ninety percent control
Thats how the long balls find the goal

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the driver dont need force
It needs timing, it needs poise, of course
Swing within yourself, eighty percent
Thats how the fairway finder is sent

[Chorus]
Driver tee it high, let it fly
Upper cut the ball, watch it climb the sky
Wide base, ball forward, spine tilted right
Swing it smooth, son, swing it polite

[Outro]
Tee it high, let it fly
Eighty percent, dont ask why
Three degrees up, ball off the heel
Thats my boy, thats the deal
